chamberychateauducs.name: Château des Ducs de Savoie
chamberychateauducs.slogan: The seat of the Savoy dukes, with a chapel built for a holy cloth.
chamberychateauducs.line: The Sainte-Chapelle here housed the Shroud of Turin from 1502 until the Savoys moved it to Turin in 1578.

chamberyelephants.name: Elephants Fountain
chamberyelephants.slogan: Four bronze-grey elephants and one very rude local nickname.
chamberyelephants.line: Inaugurated in 1838 for Comte de Boigne, it is nicknamed 'les quatre sans culs' because the elephants are joined back to back.

chamberycharmettes.name: Les Charmettes
chamberycharmettes.slogan: The hillside farmhouse where a young Rousseau learned to be happy.
chamberycharmettes.line: Here begins the short happiness of my life.

hautecombeabbey.name: Hautecombe Abbey
hautecombeabbey.slogan: Savoy's royal tombs, mirrored in the waters of Lac du Bourget.
hautecombeabbey.line: The House of Savoy made the abbey its official necropolis, and the last kings and queens of Italy are buried here.

revardbelvedere.name: Belvédère du Revard
revardbelvedere.slogan: A glass platform hung over the lake, with the Alps behind you.
revardbelvedere.line: At about 1,530 metres, the lookout shows Lac du Bourget and the Dent du Chat below and the Mont Blanc massif on clear days.
